items.title: Pay final electricity bill
items.quote: Der Rechnungsbetrag ist innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug zur Zahlung fällig.
items.computation: Invoice date (triggering event) is 14.04.2026. Under §187(1) BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 30-day period starts on 15.04.2026 (day 1). Counting 30 days forward: April 15–30 = 16 days, May 1–14 = 14 days, total 30 days → the period ends on 14.05.2026. Easter Sunday 2026 falls on 05.04.2026, so Christi Himmelfahrt (Ascension Day, a public holiday throughout Germany incl. NRW) falls 39 days later on 14.05.2026 — exactly the calculated due date. Under §193 BGB, if the last day of a period for a payment falls on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday, the period ends instead on the next business day. 15.05.2026 is a Friday and not a holiday, so the payment is due on 15.05.2026.
